approval_request_resolved_when_terminal.name: approval_request_resolved_when_terminal
approval_request_resolved_when_terminal.value: ("approval_request"."status" = 'PENDING' AND "approval_request"."resolved_at" IS NULL) OR ("approval_request"."status" <> 'PENDING' AND "approval_request"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)

media_asset_dimensions_positive.name: media_asset_dimensions_positive
media_asset_dimensions_positive.value: ("media_asset"."width" IS NULL OR "media_asset"."width" > 0) AND ("media_asset"."height" IS NULL OR "media_asset"."height" > 0)

media_asset_pending_shape.name: media_asset_pending_shape
media_asset_pending_shape.value: "media_asset"."upload_status" <> 'PENDING_UPLOAD' OR ("media_asset"."temporary_object_key" IS NOT NULL AND "media_asset"."object_key" IS NULL AND "media_asset"."verified_at" IS NULL AND "media_asset"."rejected_at" IS NULL AND "media_asset"."rejection_code" IS NULL)

media_asset_verifying_shape.name: media_asset_verifying_shape
media_asset_verifying_shape.value: "media_asset"."upload_status" <> 'VERIFYING' OR ("media_asset"."temporary_object_key" IS NOT NULL AND "media_asset"."object_key" IS NULL AND "media_asset"."verified_at" IS NULL AND "media_asset"."rejected_at" IS NULL AND "media_asset"."rejection_code" IS NULL)

media_asset_verified_shape.name: media_asset_verified_shape
media_asset_verified_shape.value: "media_asset"."upload_status" <> 'VERIFIED' OR ("media_asset"."temporary_object_key" IS NOT NULL AND "media_asset"."object_key" IS NOT NULL AND "media_asset"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "media_asset"."rejected_at" IS NULL AND "media_asset"."rejection_code" IS NULL)

media_asset_rejected_shape.name: media_asset_rejected_shape
media_asset_rejected_shape.value: "media_asset"."upload_status" <> 'REJECTED' OR ("media_asset"."object_key" IS NULL AND "media_asset"."verified_at" IS NULL AND "media_asset"."rejected_at" IS NOT NULL AND "media_asset"."rejection_code" IS NOT NULL)

organization_active_period_valid.name: organization_active_period_valid
organization_active_period_valid.value: "organization"."active_until" IS NULL OR "organization"."active_from" IS NULL OR "organization"."active_until" >= "organization"."active_from"

organization_root_parent_valid.name: organization_root_parent_valid
organization_root_parent_valid.value: ("organization"."type" = 'NSO' AND "organization"."parent_id" IS NULL AND "organization"."id" = "organization"."tenant_id" AND "organization"."depth" = 0) OR ("organization"."type" <> 'NSO' AND "organization"."parent_id" IS NOT NULL)

outbox_events_processed_at_shape.name: outbox_events_processed_at_shape
outbox_events_processed_at_shape.value:
("outbox_events"."status" IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING') AND "outbox_events"."processed_at" IS NULL)
          OR ("outbox_events"."status" IN ('SENT', 'FAILED') AND "outbox_events"."processed_at" IS NOT NULL)

project_planned_dates_valid.name: project_planned_dates_valid
project_planned_dates_valid.value: "project"."planned_end_at" IS NULL OR "project"."planned_start_at" IS NULL OR "project"."planned_end_at" >= "project"."planned_start_at"

project_actual_dates_valid.name: project_actual_dates_valid
project_actual_dates_valid.value: "project"."actual_end_at" IS NULL OR "project"."actual_start_at" IS NULL OR "project"."actual_end_at" >= "project"."actual_start_at"

project_comment_kind_field_consistent.name: project_comment_kind_field_consistent
project_comment_kind_field_consistent.value: ("project_comment"."kind" = 'GLOBAL' AND "project_comment"."field_key" IS NULL) OR ("project_comment"."kind" = 'FIELD' AND "project_comment"."field_key" IS NOT NULL)

role_assignment_scope_org_required.name: role_assignment_scope_org_required
role_assignment_scope_org_required.value: ("role_assignment"."scope_type" = 'GLOBAL_TECH' AND "role_assignment"."scope_org_id" IS NULL) OR ("role_assignment"."scope_type" <> 'GLOBAL_TECH' AND "role_assignment"."scope_org_id" IS NOT NULL)
